description.value:
Your drone changes forms. When you pick this feat, select a robot companion chassis that your drone doesn't have; your drone gains this chassis. During your daily preparations, select the customizations for all of your drone's chassis individually, then select which chassis your drone begins that day as. Your drone gains the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.Mobile Reconfiguration] action, which it can use to switch between its available chassis.

Special You can select this feat more than once, selecting a different chassis each time.
